info.name: Notifications
info.description: This application adds an internal notification system to an owncloud.online instance. Notifications are triggered by apps like Announcements or Custom Groups and shown under the bell in the header of the web interface; clients can read them through the OCS API. Mail notifications are configured per user under Settings → Notifications. Version 1.0.0 is built for the redesigned owncloud.online 11.1 web interface. This is a PHP 8.4 fork maintained by BW-Tech GmbH for owncloud.online.
info.author: Joas Schilling, Thomas Müller, modified by BW-Tech GmbH
